hypotheses.S0_exact_state_program_reconstructs_grad: The all-target local-operator program reaches at least 0.999 cosine and at most 0.02 relative error at every layer.
hypotheses.S1_nearest_reference_operator_is_reusabl: Replacing every local suffix state with the path-nearest same-position reference retains at least 0.50 median gradient cosine at every layer.
hypotheses.S2_one_operator_family_is_mostly_reusabl: At every layer, keeping either exact MLP states or exact attention states while swapping the other family reaches at least 0.70 median cosine.
hypotheses.S3_exact_near_eight_states_are_sufficien: Keeping exact states only in the next eight suffix blocks reaches at least 0.90 median cosine at every layer.
hypotheses.S4_near_states_matter_more_than_late_sta: The exact-near-eight program beats the exact-last-eight program by at least 0.10 median cosine at every layer.
hypotheses.S5_forward_similarity_selects_better_ope: The path-nearest same-position reference beats the farthest reference by at least 0.10 median cosine at every layer.
hypotheses.S6_best_single_family_hybrid_is_finitely: The better exact-MLP or exact-attention hybrid has positive finite top-64 effects on at least 75 percent of sites at every layer.
